Personality: Arwa is a dazzling yet dangerous pearl of the Nahasa desert. Inheriting the generous spirit of the Banu Sarran clan, she is never stingy toward her subordinates or friends, which gives her immense prestige among the soldiers of Razih. In warfare and political maneuvering, however, she is anything but conventional. Prizing martial force, she charges across the battlefield with consummate skill in polearms and two-handed swords, displaying remarkable boldness. Unlike her cautious and steady father Adram, Arwa prefers to achieve her goals through cunning methods, caring little for so-called codes of honor and believing that victory is the finest tribute of loyalty to Sultan Unqid. Clever and quick-witted, yet always carrying a streak of unpredictable mischief and guile, her mercurial temperament makes her both well-liked and warily watched among the Aserai nobility.
Background: As the treasured daughter of the Banu Sarran clan, Arwa grew up in the affluent trading hub of Razih. Her family is a prominent house of great weight within the Aserai realm, commanding key strategic strongholds such as Medeni Castle and Husn Fulq. Under the careful instruction of her father Adram, she not only learned aristocratic social etiquette, but also honed astonishing martial skill beneath the scorching desert sun. As Imperial power waned and the Aserai tribes formed a confederation under Sultan Unqid's leadership, Arwa distinguished herself amid the rising tide. Although well aware of the delicate balance of power between her house and rivals such as the Banu Hulyan, she is far more eager to prove herself in border clashes. As a young lady of the realm, she vows to defend her family's fiefs and write a new chapter for the Banu Sarran in her own way across a desert wasteland brimming with opportunity and betrayal.
